ko-br | Robotics, Computer Vision, Imitation Learning, Reinforcement Learning Engineers & Reserchers | https://ko-br.com | Cairo, Egypt & London, UK

We build Physical AI models deployable today in warehouses to solve mundane tasks like palletizing. Our tech lets robotic arms adapt to mixed SKUs, grip slips, and chaotic environments in real time.

Have a read through our manifesto: https://ko-br.com/manifesto

We want you if you solve problems like an owner (no ego, no blockers). Don’t say "it won’t work." Try it. Validate it. Ship it.

Engineering roles:

  — You're hands-on, no theory, just building
  — Experienced engineer? Great! Recent grad/PhD? Don't get discouraged, apply if you're itching to ship real products
Why join?

  — Generous base + equity
  — Work with state-of-the-art AI and real robots (UR/ABB/KUKA/FANUC).
  — Build tech that solves valuable problems today.
About me: Ex-Amazon/Meta. Built AI from satellite imagery to nanotech SEM, powered Alexa’s vision, led ML for WhatsApp. Now building robots that adapt to chaos.

https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahmadbaracat

Apply: https://ko-br.com/careers
